image_description: A low-angle, close-up view of a maypole decorated with colorful ribbons and a floral wreath near the top. The pole is wooden and vertical. Multiple red and patterned streamers radiate outwards from the top section. In the foreground, the backs/heads of people (likely dancers) are visible holding the ends of the ribbons. The background features bare tree branches against a blue sky, suggesting an outdoor park setting in early spring or late autumn.
